2186. Student Record Management Using realloc()

90

Hard

A college wants to maintain student records dynamically. Initially, the system stores N student records. Later, K additional students join the college.

Write a C program using structures and dynamic memory allocation to expand the student records.

Define a structure  Student  containing:

Register Number

Student Name

Marks

Your program should:

Read the initial number of students N.

Allocate memory using  malloc()  for N student records.

Read the details of N students.

Read K, the number of additional students.

Expand the allocated memory using  realloc() .

Read the additional student records.

Calculate and print the average marks of all students.

Identify and print the student with the highest marks.

Release the allocated memory using  free() .
input_spec:
First line contains N.

Next N lines contain register number, name and marks.

Next line contains K.

Next K lines contain additional student records.
output_spec:
